verdict.rationale: Phoenix's Python SDK is explicitly documented (modular install, tracing decorators, auto_instrument) and OTLP/OpenInference tracing is well covered, and JS/TS usage is implied via auto-instrumentation for JS-native frameworks (Mastra, Vercel AI SDK) and an npx-based CLI setup script for app roots. However, there is no explicit mention of a dedicated, officially-branded JS/TS SDK package (e.g., an @arizeai JS tracing SDK) with its own API docs, so JS/TS support is inferred rather than directly documented to the same depth as Python. Missing for 10: explicit JS/TS SDK package documentation and API reference, parity of manual instrumentation decorators for JS/TS.
